tools.name: browse_category
tools.description: List the best-ranked products on Microlaunch in a category (e.g. 'AI', 'marketing', 'dev tools', 'productivity', 'SEO', 'no-code'). Use for 'best X tools' or 'what tools exist for Y' questions. If the category is unknown, the result lists valid categories.

tools.name: top_launches
tools.description: Get the current Microlaunch leaderboard: top-ranked launches from today, the last 7 days or the last 30 days, optionally filtered by category slug (e.g. ai, marketing, dev-tools, productivity, seo). Use for 'what's new/trending in indie products' questions.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get details for one Microlaunch product by its slug (from browse_category or top_launches results): description, category, stage, votes, reviews count and awards.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: List active discounts and lifetime deals from indie makers on Microlaunch, optionally by category slug. Codes are revealed on Microlaunch, not here.
